facts.population: Patients with complete dentures (11 included clinical studies)
facts.intervention: Digitally fabricated (3D printed or milled) complete dentures
facts.main_result: Fabrication technique influenced complication type and number; results for occlusion and retention were contradictory, and digital dentures needed similar or more follow-up visits.
facts.sample_size: 11 studies included of 63 articles (6 RCTs, 5 non-RCTs)
facts.limitations: Heterogeneity of populations and data collection methods precluded statistical analysis.

facts.population: Edentulous patients who received removable complete dentures
facts.intervention: Digitally designed and manufactured RCDs (milling and/or 3D printing)
facts.main_result: No significant differences between digital and conventional RCD workflows in laboratory (MD -239.77 USD), clinical, total costs (MD -357.76 USD) or sessions (MD -1.47).
